about: Browsing shelves. Names are playful (Vol. II §11: social and marketing may be playful, in-world); taglines say plainly what is on the shelf. Rules (media, all_tags, any_tags, min_strength, popularity_min/max, relation_child, continuity, min/max_minutes, languages, not_languages, sort) are evaluated by catalogue/browse.py and demo/engine.cjs. A shelf with fewer than three works is hidden. 'Comedy Central' is a TV channel's trademark, so the comedy shelf is 'Laugh Riot'.
